name: barbell hang power clean
description: An explosive lift from the hang position that brings the bar to the shoulders. It trains power through the hips, legs and traps.
instructions: Hold the bar at mid-thigh with an overhand grip and a flat back.
Hinge slightly so the bar sits just above your knees.
Jump and shrug explosively, extending hips and knees.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower the bar back to the hang.
